end.summary:
Manav identified deer as a plant-eater that eats grass.
They identified grass as the start of a food chain.
They built the chain mango leaf → caterpillar with a correct arrow direction.
They read the example chain algae → larvae → fish.
They did not complete what fish eat in the final chain question.
end.parentNote: Asha practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, both-eaters, and simple food chains with Manav. They used the reason that a caterpillar eats a leaf to place the arrow correctly. Manav repeated some answers when the question was asked again, and the food-chain reading was corrected or extended during the lesson; the final question about what fish eat was not completed. At home, ask them to make two short chains using arrows and say what each animal eats.
